artworks.title: Le couché de la mariée
artworks.artist: Jean-Michel Moreau and Jean-Baptiste Blaise Simonet after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin
artworks.description: The image shows an interior setting with elegantly dressed women engaged in various activities. They are positioned around a large, ornate bed with an elaborate canopy. One woman is seated near a lit candlestick, while another rests her head on the bed's soft furnishings. The women have elaborate hairstyles and wear flowing, layered gowns with intricate details. The room features a high ceiling with embellished moldings, engraved panels, grand columns, and decorative carvings, creating a sense of grandeur.

artworks.title: Le curieux
artworks.description: This print depicts two women in an elaborately decorated room, with a man looking through the window of a door on the left. In the center, one of the women sits on a bench, facing the left. She is wearing a bonnet and a voluminous dress. Her skirts have been pushed up to expose her legs and buttocks, with her legs stretched out on the couch. On the left, the other woman stands next to her. This woman has a lace bonnet over her hair and wears a similar dress with ruffles and voluminous skirts. She holds a large needle or syringe and is bending down towards the woman on the couch. A small dog stands by her feet, its legs propped up on the couch. Behind the standing woman is a doorway on the left with a window on the top. A man is peeking into the room, pushing the curtain of the window aside. The room is adorned with ornate wall decorations and decorative furniture such as a table on the right and a large mirror, and the floor is covered in a patterned rug. The print is surrounded by a border of off-white paper.

artworks.title: Le danger du tete-a-tete
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Blaise Simonet after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a woman with visible upper bodies seated in an ornate interior setting. The woman is sitting on a chair, while the man is kneeling beside her, gesturing towards her. The woman has her hair styled in an elaborate updo and is wearing an elegant gown. The man is dressed in an 18th-century style suit. The setting is lavish with decorative elements such as drapery, a ceramic vase, and intricate furniture. The room is furnished with carved chairs, and a patterned carpet is seen on the floor. The decor reflects an aristocratic style.

artworks.title: L'enlevement nocturne
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene featuring a group of individuals in a wooded area. Two horse-drawn carriages are present, with riders and bystanders interacting. One figure is elevated among trees, appearing to be assisted or pulled down. The setting includes detailed trees and foliage, with an architectural element visible in the background.

artworks.title: L'Epouse indiscrete
artworks.description: The image shows a person reclining on a luxurious bed with elaborate fabric curtains. They have curly hair, detailed clothing, and are surrounded by opulent décor. The setting includes a plush bed, ornate canopy, richly decorated curtains, and intricate wood paneling. Another figure is partially visible sitting in a chair to the right, with similar styled hair and clothing.

artworks.title: Le fruit de l'amour secret
artworks.description: This print shows a lavishly decorated room with ornate furnishings. In the center is a large canopy with heavy, patterned curtains. Under it, a woman sits on what appears to be a cushioned chair. She wears a gown with a low neckline and a cloth covering wrapped over her head. To the left, two people in cloaks and hats stand in front of an open doorway, carrying a swaddled infant. One of the woman's hands grasps the cloth around the infant. Her head, however, is turned to the right, looking at a person who sits in a chair, their back to us. This person wears a long jacket and has tightly curled hair, and they have their left arm outstretched to hold the woman's other hand. Another person, perhaps a child, also stands in front of the woman, looking up at her. This person has their back to us as well, and they wear a long, flowing gown, and have their hair in an updo. On the right is a tall open window, and near the bottom left is a stack of pillows and blankets. The walls appear to be painted with intricate designs. Below the print is a border of off-white paper, featuring a crest at the bottom with a crown and shield.

artworks.title: Le Goûter
artworks.description: This print shows a group of people in an outdoor space filled with green and blue foliage and a decorative column leading to a curved wall. In the center, a woman in a blue gown with a lacy white neckline and a decorative hat is seated on a bench. Next to her, a child in a pink dress points one arm to the left, her back to us. A man in a red coat is seated on the right across a round blue table. These three people have pale skin, and the adults have gray hair while the child has light brown hair. Behind them, another person in a robe and turban holds a tray with small cups. This person has darker skin and is bending down towards the woman. On the left, two people on a staircase can be seen from the chest up, embracing. Baskets of flowers are in the bottom left corner, and a doll in a pink dress lays by more flowers in the bottom right.

artworks.title: Le Goûter
artworks.description: The image shows several people seated around a table in an outdoor setting. A woman sits on the left, wearing a blue gown and a white hat, with loose curly hair. Next to her is a young child in a pink dress. Across the table is a man wearing an 18th-century red coat and breeches, with a powdered wig. Another figure in brown turban and robes stands behind the table, reaching out towards the group. In the background are tall trees, a garden, and an architectural structure with columns. The scene appears luxurious and lush, with a peaceful atmosphere. Additionally, there is a cherub peeking from behind foliage.

artworks.title: Le Déjeuné
artworks.artist: Louis-Marin Bonnet after Jean-Baptiste Hüet, I
artworks.description: This print shows a group of five adults, a child, and a dog outdoors. The people have light skin and gray hair and are gathered around a small wooden table. There are three women and two men. On the left is a woman in a beige dress with a blue petticoat who is seated on a chair and holding her skirt flat. The two men are gathered around her, appearing to rinse a spot of her skirt with water. One of the men is in a red coat and blue breeches, and the other is in a black coat. At the edge of the table by the seated woman, a small child in a pink outfit holds one fist up to their eye with a distressed expression. On the right side of the table, two women stand, one in a pink dress and a wide brimmed hat with a red ribbon, and the other with a tan dress. A black tricorn hat lays on the ground on the bottom right, and on the left a small dog looks up at the scene. The background consists of tall trees, green shrubs, and a white tent-like structure behind the group. The sky is light blue and cloudy.

artworks.title: Jusques dans la moindre chose
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a woman depicted from the waist up, seated on a garden bench. She is positioned in profile facing to her right, appearing relaxed with her left hand resting on an open book on her lap. The woman has delicate facial features and her hair is covered by a cap that ties under her chin. She wears a dress with puffed sleeves. Surrounding her on the bench are some personal belongings, including a partially visible basket beside her. The background shows lush foliage with a potted plant bearing blooming flowers next to her, and a large tree stretching upwards. The scene is enclosed within an ornate oval frame. Below the oval, there is an empty plaque within the rectangular border of the image.

artworks.title: Jusques dans la moindre chose
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman from the knees up, positioned on a bench with her body slightly turned to her left and her head inclined forward. Her facial features are serene, complemented by an elaborate headscarf or bonnet. She wears a long dress with ruffled details. The woman holds a small object in her hands above an open book in her lap. Surrounding her are potted plants with blooming flowers. The background features dense foliage, all encased within an ornate oval frame.

artworks.title: Marton
artworks.description: The image features a woman within a decorative oval frame, holding a basket of flowers above her head. She is dressed in a gown with intricate details, characterized by puffed sleeves and a fitted bodice. The setting includes lush foliage, a decorative urn, and trees in the background. A cherub is nestled amid the flowers in the basket.

artworks.title: Sa taille est ravissante
artworks.artist: Pierre Adrien Le Beau after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin
artworks.description: The woman in the image is pictured from the waist up, turned slightly to the side while facing the viewer. She is applying powder to her upper chest using a powder puff and a nearby mirror on a table. She has a gentle expression with defined facial features and styled hair topped with a ribbon or bow. Her attire includes an elaborate gown with off-the-shoulder puffed sleeves, emphasizing her waist, and accessorized with lace and frills. She wears a choker necklace and holds the powder puff in her right hand. The table is cluttered with grooming items such as bottles and a covered container. The background shows draped fabric and a floral detailed chair. The scene is enclosed within a decorative circular frame against a plain backdrop.

artworks.title: Sa taille est ravissante
artworks.artist: Pierre Adrien Le Beau after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated at a vanity. She has delicate features, styled hair adorned with a bow and a confident expression. She is wearing an off-the-shoulder dress with ruffled sleeves. The vanity holds various objects. The woman's right hand holds a small item. The background includes a textured chair and the scene is framed within an oval boundary.

artworks.title: Le lever
artworks.description: The image shows three women in a room. The central woman is sitting on a bed. She is wearing a gown and her hair is styled in an updo. A dog is next to her. Two attendants are nearby, one standing and one kneeling, arranging fabric. The background has drapery and a folding screen. The scene is framed with a decorative border.

artworks.title: La toilette
artworks.artist: Nicolas Ponce after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin with border by Charles-Nicolas Cochin II
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals within an elegantly decorated room. In the center, a woman stands near a bed, slightly turned towards a seated man on the right. Beside her, another woman assists with her attire. The man is dressed in fine attire, with a waistcoat and breeches. The room features a richly adorned wall, heavy drapery framing a window, and a small dog sitting beside the women. An intricate border surrounds the entire composition, featuring floral motifs and circular designs.

artworks.title: Le matin
artworks.artist: Emmanuel Jean Nepomucène de Ghendt after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene that features a bed with ornate drapery. The room includes a grand four-poster bed adorned with decorative curtains, a figure reclining on the bed surrounded by pillows and sheets, a small table with a lit candle, and a partially visible figure in the open doorway. The drawing is detailed and precise, conveying a sense of refined elegance and historical charm.

artworks.title: Le midi
artworks.artist: Emmanuel Jean Nepomucène de Ghendt after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin

artworks.title: Le soir
artworks.artist: Emmanuel Jean Nepomucène de Ghendt after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin

artworks.title: La nuit
artworks.artist: Emmanuel Jean Nepomucène de Ghendt after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin
artworks.description: Two people are shown near a statue in an outdoor setting. Both figures' full bodies are visible. The person on the left is reclining on the grass and leaning backward slightly, while the person on the right is kneeling and leaning forward towards the other. The reclining figure has delicate facial features and wears an elegant dress with lace trim and a decorative hat. The kneeling figure has long hair tied back and is dressed in a flowing garment. A winged statue of a cherub is seated on a pedestal to the right. The cherub rests one hand on its chest and looks downward. Around them, the setting is lush with trees and greenery. In the background, a crescent moon is visible through the partly cloudy night sky.

artworks.title: Marchez tout doux, parlez tout bas
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with intricate details of woodwork and furniture. In the center of the room, one figure appears surprised or alarmed, while another is at the window holding a pair of shoes. The room features a bed, detailed fabric, and a side door leading to another area. The drawing has classical elements and emotional expressions, suggesting a sense of narrative drama within a domestic setting. An ornate border and decorative emblem frame the illustration at the bottom.

artworks.title: Le modèle honnête
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of an interior scene. The room is decorated with elegant furniture and lavish decor, including a large window with heavy drapes. A person is seated on a couch, surrounded by well-dressed individuals. One person is painting on a canvas on an easel. The room is ornately decorated with wall moldings, a vase of flowers on a table, and framed artworks on the walls, creating a sophisticated atmosphere. The drawing showcases intricate details in the fabric, furniture, and decor, illustrating a refined and cultured setting.
